entries.snippet: The Abstract Expressionist's Number 7A, 1948 painting is now his most expensive artwork ever sold at auction.

entries.title: Two dead in Spain shooting, with babies reportedly among injured
entries.snippet: Police say a 25-year-old man is suspected of killing his parents and injuring four others in southern Spain.

entries.title: Tasmanian government apologises over stolen body parts scandal
entries.snippet: An investigation found that 177 human specimens from dozens of bodies were secretly kept by a museum.

entries.snippet: Starbucks withdrew the campaign for its drink tumblers after many said it referenced a bloody crackdown.

entries.snippet: The US president says he is holding off on an attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".

entries.snippet: The settlement will go towards individuals who allege they were subjected to unfair investigations.

entries.title: In Georgia, Republican primary for governor goes to a runoff between Trump backers

entries.title: Endorsed by Trump, Ed Gallrein defeats Rep. Thomas Massie in GOP House primary
entries.snippet: In a major victory for President Trump, his hand-picked challenger, Ed Gallrein, beat out U.S. House Rep. Thomas Massie in a Kentucky House GOP primary, ending Massie's reelection bid.

entries.title: 'Taiwan Travelogue' wins the 2026 International Booker Prize
entries.snippet: The novel is the first work translated from Mandarin Chinese to win the award, which celebrates its 10th anniversary this year.

entries.title: Trump endorses Ken Paxton over incumbent John Cornyn in Texas Senate primary runoff
entries.snippet: President Trump has endorsed Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton over incumbent Sen. John Cornyn in the Texas GOP runoff for U.S. Senate, one week before voting ends in the contentious and expensive primary.

entries.title: Minnesota becomes first state to ban prediction markets
entries.snippet: While dozens of states have taken legal action against the controversial industry, Minnesota is the first state to pass a law making it a felony for companies like Kalshi and Polymarket to operate.

entries.title: States sue over new student loan limits on certain nursing and healthcare degrees
entries.snippet: New York, Arizona, North Carolina, Kentucky and Nevada are among the states challenging a rule that limits federal student loans for graduate degrees in nursing, physical therapy and more.

entries.title: Can't keep a habit? This comic shares a proven formula to make it stick
entries.snippet: In this illustrated guide, behavioral scientist BJ Fogg breaks down his Tiny Habits framework to help you rethink your approach to starting (or restarting) a habit.

entries.title: A study investigates: Did the abrupt end of USAID have an impact on violence?
entries.snippet: That's the provocative question that researchers dug into after the U.S. shut down its premier aid agency.

entries.title: Israel's trying to expel a whole Palestinian district in East Jerusalem, activists say
entries.snippet: Israeli authorities are issuing Palestinians demolition orders in East Jerusalem at an accelerated rate since Israel launched war with Iran, human rights groups and U.N. experts say.

entries.title: Israeli forces intercept the remaining activist flotilla vessels headed for Gaza
entries.snippet: A live feed on the Global Sumud Flotilla website showed armed Israeli soldiers boarding the vessels as activists in life vests put their hands up. Soldiers then destroyed cameras mounted on the vessels.

entries.title: Senate advances bill aimed at ending Iran war as Cassidy, after primary loss, flips to support it
entries.snippet: The Senate advanced legislation Tuesday that seeks to force President Donald Trump to withdraw from the Iran war, as a growing number of Republicans defied the president's wishes.

entries.title: School official did nothing after being told about a 6-year-old student with a gun, prosecutor says
entries.snippet: An assistant principal at a Virginia elementary school shook off repeated warnings that a 6-year-old student had a gun that was later used to shoot his teacher, a prosecutor said Tuesday.

entries.title: Trump administration plans to admit more white South Africans as refugees this year
entries.snippet: The Trump administration plans to admit up to 10,000 more white South African refugees into the United States, citing discrimination against Afrikaners.

entries.title: NAACP calls for boycott of Southern college sports programs over voting rights
entries.snippet: The NAACP is calling on Black athletes, alumni, fans and the general public to boycott the athletic programs of public universities in states that aim to redistrict longtime Black lawmakers.

entries.title: WATCH: Trump calls planned White House ballroom 'a gift' to U.S.
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump is defending the White House ballroom he's building. He showed off the construction site to a group of reporters on Tuesday.

entries.title: Affordable Care Act enrollment projected to plunge by 5 million as costs spike, analysis shows
entries.snippet: The report found that ACA program enrollment could shrink by more than 20% and that those who remain covered are paying more, with average deductibles growing by over $1,000.

entries.title: Blanche faces senators on new Trump 'weaponization' fund, Epstein, budget cuts
entries.snippet: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche faced lawmakers Tuesday for the first time since taking the role, answering to bipartisan questions about his department's newly created "Anti-Weaponization Fund."

entries.title: NATO's top officer doesn't expect more U.S. drawdowns beyond the 5,000 troops Trump announced
entries.snippet: The remarks by U.S. Lt. Gen. Alex Grynkewich follow Trump's surprise announcement of the move early this month.

entries.title: Ketanji Brown Jackson says Supreme Court risks being seen as political after voting rights decision
entries.snippet: At a time when public confidence in the court is low, Jackson said the court must be careful to avoid being seen as political.

entries.title: More than 17,000 under evacuation orders as Southern California wildfire threatens homes
entries.snippet: The Sandy Fire in hills above Simi Valley, northwest of Los Angeles, had consumed more than two square miles of dry brush as of Tuesday. There is zero containment.

entries.title: U.S. government agrees to drop tax claims against Trump in broadening of IRS lawsuit settlement
entries.snippet: The one-page document posted to the Department of Justice website Tuesday says the U.S. is "forever barred and precluded" from examining or prosecuting Trump, his sons and the Trump organization's current tax issues.

entries.title: San Diego mosque shooters met online and left writings expressing hate, FBI says
entries.snippet: Mark Remily of the FBI said during a news conference that authorities have uncovered writings by the suspects. Authorities declined to specify what ideologies or views were expressed by the shooters.

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Vance hails 'good progress' in Iran talks
entries.snippet: US Vice President JD Vance said Washington remained "locked and loaded" in the event of failed negotiations. It comes a day after Donald Trump said he called off an attack on Iran at three Gulf nations' request.

entries.title: US troop withdrawal from Europe to take 'years' — general
entries.snippet: NATO top commander Alexus Grynkewich said the US withdrawal would be "well-synchronized" with European allies. It comes after Donald Trump announced a decision to pull 5,000 troops out of Germany.

entries.title: Hungary's new Prime Minister Magyar seeks to fix Poland ties
entries.snippet: Peter Magyar hopes to mend relations with Poland during his first state visit to Warsaw. What lessons could he learn from Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk?

entries.title: $181.2 million Pollock shatters auction record at Christie's
entries.snippet: The work from the collection of publishing magnate S.I. Newhouse led auction week at Christie's in New York. The canvas was included in a billion dollar sale.

entries.title: Rising Cuba-US tensions amid talk of drones, emergency plans
entries.snippet: Cuba’s reported purchase of drones and renewed threats with the US are stoking fears of escalation. Amid blackouts and shortages, many Cubans expressed outrage at official advice to prepare for potential attack.

entries.title: Pioneer of pop music: Cher turns 80
entries.snippet: Cher has had countless hits and sparked more than a few controversies — while always doing things her own way. At 80, she remains as iconic as ever.

entries.title: Russian President Vladimir Putin in Beijing for talks with Chinese leader Xi Jinping
entries.snippet: Russia’s president is in Beijing for a meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping, only days after a visit by Donald Trump. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Germany beefs up civil defense
entries.snippet: Germany's government wants to spend €10 billion to better protect its population in case of emergencies. The backlog is huge.

entries.title: NATO planes down suspected Ukrainian drone over Estonia
entries.snippet: A NATO military jet has shot down a suspected Ukrainian drone in Estonian airspace. As Ukraine targets Russia's Baltic oil facilities more often and more intensely, more such drones are straying into allies' territory.

entries.title: China's zero-tariff for Africa: Win-win or winner takes all?
entries.snippet: China has opened its market to 53 African countries, calling it a “golden key” to prosperity. But while new opportunities emerge, analysts warn the reality for African economies is more complex.

entries.title: Iran war: Why is Trump blaming the Kurds?
entries.snippet: Donald Trump says Kurdish forces kept US weapons meant for Iranian protesters, allegations Kurdish leaders categorically deny. Analysts say the president is scapegoating the groups to make up for his own policy failures.

entries.title: How brain-guided hearing aids may one day help users
entries.snippet: In a crowded room, it can be impossible for hearing aid users to focus on what they want or need to hear. Research into auditory neurotechnology may enhance sounds and voices and reduce noise in real-time.

entries.title: Spanish ex-PM Zapatero investigated over airline bailout
entries.snippet: A Spanish court says it is probing ex-Prime Minister Jose Luis Rodriguez Zapatero for alleged influence peddling. The case puts more pressure on the current premier, Pedro Sanchez, who is dogged by corruption probes.

entries.title: Czechia: Uproar over Sudeten German gathering in Brno
entries.snippet: The first gathering of Sudeten Germans in Czechia since World War II is set to go ahead this weekend despite a political backlash that has exposed tensions over one of Central Europe's most painful historical legacies.

entries.title: WHO concerned by 'scale and speed' of Ebola spread in DRC
entries.snippet: Congo's Health Ministry has logged 131 suspected deaths and 513 potential cases in the latest outbreak in the country's east. The World Health Organization is holding an emergency meeting on Tuesday in Geneva.

entries.title: South Korea, Japan agree to boost energy cooperation
entries.snippet: The South Korean and Japanese leaders, whose nations have not always had good relations, have vowed deeper ties at talks. They reaffirmed stronger security coordination and energy cooperation in challenging times.

entries.title: Freiburg's Europa League final proof another way can work
entries.snippet: Bundesliga side Freiburg are in their first ever European final. Their European run is a reminder that success in football can be achieved without big spending and without sacrifcing identity.

entries.title: Sweden orders 4 frigates from French company Naval Group
entries.snippet: Sweden plans to acquire four new frigates starting in 2030 in a deal worth billions. They will be the largest surface warships in Sweden's navy. The newest NATO member is rushing to build up its military capabilities.

entries.title: Germany news: 3 missing after Görlitz house collapse
entries.snippet: Three people are still missing after a house collapsed in the eastern German city of Görlitz on Monday evening, while a study has found that one in five German gas stations have breached pricing laws.
